lines.cap: Every mansion keeps one window lit at three AM. Never the same one twice.
lines.say: Every mansion keeps one window lit at three AM. Never the same one twice.

lines.cap: Drive past any old money street at night. Count. One light. Always one.
lines.say: Drive past any old money street at night. Count. One light. Always one.

lines.cap: It's a job. They call it the watcher. Paid in gold to stay awake till sunrise.
lines.say: It's a job. They call it the watcher. Paid in gold to stay awake till sunrise.

lines.cap: Watching what? The street. The neighbours. You.
lines.say: Watching what? The street. The neighbours. You.

lines.cap: The only rule. The watcher must never close the curtain.
lines.say: The only rule. The watcher must never close the curtain.

lines.cap: I zoomed in on one. The watcher was a cardboard cutout. He'd been asleep since 2009.
